fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami’s tourist season and the impact of law-enforcement actions on entertainment (closures and restrictions on dancing), along with pieces criticizing professional receiverships and local financial conditions. Coverage also addresses local civic and infrastructure matters including the Miami Chamber of Commerce, parking enforcement, Florida East Coast Railway properties, and public transportation conditions and racial segregation on streetcars and buses. Additional content includes humor/verse columns, letters to the editor, and substantial local advertising for Miami and Miami Beach businesses and venues.
